tools.name: render_page
tools.description: Render a JavaScript page in a real browser; returns rendered HTML, text, optional screenshot. (browser; $0.02/call in USDC via x402, 10 free/day).

tools.name: screenshot_page
tools.description: Screenshot a page (real browser) as a base64 PNG/JPEG. (browser; $0.02/call in USDC via x402, 10 free/day).

tools.name: extract_content
tools.description: Extract a page's main content as clean Markdown + text with metadata. (content; $0.005/call in USDC via x402, 30 free/day).

tools.name: resolve_url
tools.description: Follow a URL's full redirect chain; return final URL, hops, and metadata. (web-intel; $0.003/call in USDC via x402, 50 free/day).

tools.name: unfurl_url
tools.description: Link preview card (title, description, image, favicon) for any URL. (content; $0.003/call in USDC via x402, 50 free/day).

tools.name: get_feed
tools.description: Discover and parse a site's RSS/Atom feed into JSON items. (content; $0.003/call in USDC via x402, 40 free/day).

tools.name: get_oembed
tools.description: Rich embed (oEmbed) data for a media URL (YouTube, Vimeo, X, Spotify...). (content; $0.002/call in USDC via x402, 50 free/day).

tools.name: find_favicon
tools.description: Find a site's best icon/logo. (web-intel; $0.002/call in USDC via x402, 50 free/day).

tools.name: check_robots
tools.description: Parse robots.txt; answer whether a user-agent may crawl a path; list sitemaps. (web-intel; $0.002/call in USDC via x402, 50 free/day).

tools.name: inspect_headers
tools.description: HTTP response headers + security-header analysis for a URL. (web-intel; $0.002/call in USDC via x402, 50 free/day).

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Full DNS record dump (A/AAAA/MX/NS/TXT/SOA/CAA/CNAME) for a host. (domain-dns; $0.003/call in USDC via x402, 50 free/day).

tools.name: ssl_lookup
tools.description: TLS certificate details (issuer, expiry, SANs) via Certificate Transparency logs. (domain-dns; $0.004/call in USDC via x402, 40 free/day).

tools.name: whois_lookup
tools.description: Deep domain registration record via RDAP (registrar, dates, nameservers, DNSSEC). (domain-dns; $0.005/call in USDC via x402, 40 free/day).

tools.name: extract_pdf
tools.description: Extract text + metadata from a PDF URL (text-based PDFs). (content; $0.01/call in USDC via x402, 20 free/day).

tools.name: generate_qr
tools.description: Generate a QR code (SVG) for text or a URL. (utility; $0.002/call in USDC via x402, 50 free/day).

tools.name: diff_pages
tools.description: Compare two pages (or one page vs its latest Wayback snapshot); return what changed. (content; $0.008/call in USDC via x402, 25 free/day).

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Check domain availability across TLDs via RDAP. Set enriched=true for DNS, age, and Wayback history. (domain-dns; $0.004/call in USDC via x402, 50 free/day).
